game_concept: A arcade set in The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens, the chapel gardens: the herald must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected arrows into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the castle gate.
theme: The Kingdom – Chapel Gardens: the chapel gardens
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Chapel Gardens'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Chapel Gardens.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 300 within 45 seconds.
